About Cosync

Helping people know who is really behind the message.

Cosync develops identity technology that makes strong authentication practical for developers and understandable for the people who use it.

From passwordless access to attested communication.

AppKey began with a clear goal: help applications adopt passkeys without forcing every team to become a WebAuthn specialist. AppKeyId extends that thinking beyond login—using cryptographic identity to help people verify the origin of important communications.

In an era of synthetic media and automated impersonation, the company’s focus is simple: create identity proof that recipients can verify before they trust a request.

RK
Founder & CEO

Richard Krueger

Technologist, builder, and advocate for practical digital trust.

Richard Krueger founded Cosync and leads the development of AppKey and AppKeyId. His work centers on making modern identity standards accessible to product teams—and on applying passkey technology to the emerging problem of trustworthy communication in an AI-mediated world.

Through Cosync’s products and writing, Richard explores the point where identity, security, and human behavior meet: not only whether a person can log in, but whether others can trust the actions and communications that follow.

Our principles

Security people can actually use.

Strong cryptography matters most when it produces clear, confident decisions for real people.

01

Prove, don’t imply

Important trust claims should be backed by verifiable evidence.

02

Keep secrets local

Private credentials should remain protected on the user’s device.

03

Design for adoption

Security succeeds when the safe action is also the understandable action.
